what: One call of claude-haiku-5-5 per arm, asked to call WebSearch once (the prompt is in the driver of the author's record); the stream is reduced to counts and classes: no search text, no answer text, no host path is kept.

websearch_arms.error_class: PreToolUse hook error (blocking: the runner file is missing, python3 exits 2)

user_prompt_submit_arms.result: the prompt is blocked: 'UserPromptSubmit operation blocked by hook', 0 turns

user_prompt_submit_arms.arm: UserPromptSubmit hook, existence-checked registration, same missing file

reading: The hook alone does not enforce: a runner that exits 1 (a crash, or a timeout) lets the marked call through, as the unmarked control; a runner whose file is missing exits 2 and blocks the call in every session, marked or not.
The overlay removes WebSearch from the model's tools: the model made no WebSearch call in either overlay arm, whatever the runner did.
A missing file under a bare `python3 <file>` registration blocks the user's prompt itself (UserPromptSubmit exit 2); the existence-checked registration does not.
